name: Trigonometry
description: The available functions are sin, cos, tan, asin, acos and atan. If an invalid number is input, the output will be 0. Sin, cos and tan accept inputs measured in turns. Asin, acos and atan output values measured in turns. The function can be set by selecting this component with the select tool.
shortDescription: Provides a set of basic trigonometry functions.

logicNodes.label: f(x)
logicNodes.description: f(x), where f is the selected function and x is the input.
